entries.text: The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.24.0.1 to 30.24.0.2 (fork commit `010db57fe835`), which adds the `netezza`, `greenplum`, `vertica`, `datafusion` and `questdb` dialects, SQLite, DuckDB, Snowflake and Databricks generator changes and the rewrite modules behind `apply_rewrite`. A translation corpus of every shipped benchmark query across 20 target dialects changes in 16 of 25,240 outputs. Results published before this change for the affected queries and dialects were computed with different SQL:
details: ClickBench Q43, nyctaxi `surcharge-revenue`, `trips-per-day` and `trips-per-month`, read_primitives `groupby_all_complex` and `timeseries_trend_analysis`, and TSBS `double-groupby-1-hr`, `double-groupby-5-min` and `resource-utilization` on SQLite: `TIMESTAMP_TRUNC` (not an SQLite function) now emits `STRFTIME` (9 outputs).
TPC-Havoc `6_v2` and `14_v2` on Spark, Databricks and Snowflake: the empty `GROUP BY ()` is dropped (6 outputs).
ClickBench Q29 on Snowflake: the non-capturing group `(?:www\.)?` in the `REGEXP_REPLACE` pattern is written as a capturing group, because Snowflake lacks non-capturing groups.
